TERMINATIONOFSUBLEASEAGREEMENT THIS TERMINATION OF SUBLEASE AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), datedasof April22,2025,betweenBARKREALTYCOMPANYLLC,alimitedliability companydulyorganizedandexisting underthelawsof theStateof NewYork(the "Sublessor"), having its principal office at c/o Jared Bark, 35 Drew Road, Warwick, New York 10990, party of the first part, and BARK FRAMEWORKS, INC., a corporation duly organized and existing under the laws of the State of New York (the “Sublessee"), having its principal office at 21-24 44th Avenue, Long Island City, New York 11101, party of the second part (terms not defined herein shall have the same meanings as used in the Sublease Agreement defined below). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, on April 30, 1999, the Agency issued its Industrial Development Revenue Bonds (1999 Bark Frameworks, Inc. Project) in the aggregate principal amount of $2,025,000 (the “Bonds") to finance a portion of the cost of the acquisition, renovation and equipping of a manufacturing facility (the “Facility") within the City, consisting of the acquisition of an approximately 27,000 square foot building on an approximately 15,000 square foot parcel of real property located at 21-24 44th Avenue, Long Island City, New York, as described in Exhibit. A attached hereto, the construction of improvements and renovations to the building, and the acquisition and installation of machinery and equipment in connection therewith, all for use by the Sublessee, for the manufacturing of custom-made crafted hardwood, gold leaf and welded metal picture frames and hand blown framed mirrors (the "1999 Project'); and WHEREAS, in connection with the 1999 Project, (i) the Sublessor conveyed fee title to the Facility Realty to the Agency pursuant to a deed, dated April 30, 1999, recorded on June 2, 1999 in the Office of The City Register of The City of New York in Queens County (the "Register's Office") in Reel 5257 and Page 348, (i) the Agency leased the Facility to the Sublessor pursuant to a Lease Agreement, dated as of April 1, 1999, between the Agency and the Sublessor, recorded on June 2, 1999 in the Register's Office in Reel 5257 and Page 447 (the "1999 Lease'), and (i) the Sublessor subleased the Facility to the Sublessee pursuant to a Sublease Agreement, dated as of April 1, 1999, between the Sublessor and the Sublessee, Sublease"); and WHEREAS, the Sublessor advised the Agency that it intended to redeem the Bonds in full but requested that the Agency continue to provide to the Sublessor the existing real Lease, pursuant to the Agency's Industry Incentive Program (Straight-Lease) transaction, and the Agency desired to accommodatesuchrequest in accordancewith therequirements of anAgency Lease Agreement, dated as of August 1, 2014, between the Agency and the Sublessor, recorded on September 10, 2014 in the Register's Office at CRFN 2014000300533 (the “Lease Agreement"); and 3974733.2 048144 CLD

2. WHEREAS, to effect the foregoing, on August 18, 2014, the Agency and the Sublessor entered into a Straight-Lease Transaction pursuant to which (i) the Agency entered into the Company Lease, dated as of August 1, 2014, which was recorded in the Register's Office on September 10, 2014 at CRFN 2014000300530 (the “Company Lease"), leasing the Facility Realty to itself; (i) the Agency conveyed its fee interest in the Facility Realty back to the Sublessor pursuant to a deed (the “Facility Deed'") that was recorded in the Register's Office on September 10,2014 at CRFN 2014000300531,which caused the Sublessor to be the lessor under the Company Lease; (i) the Agency and the Sublessor terminated the 1999 Lease, the Sublessor and theSublessee terminated the1999Sublease andcertain other documents related to the 1999 Project and the Bonds were terminated; (iv) the Agency subleased its interest in the Facility Realty, and leased the Facility Personalty, to the Sublessor pursuant to the Lease Agreement; and (v) the Sublessor sub-subleased its interest in the Facility Realty, and subleased the Facility Personalty, to the Sublessee pursuant to the Sublease Agreement, dated as of August 1, 2014, which was recorded in the Register's Office on September 10, 2014 at CRFN 2014000300534,between the Sublessor and the Sublessee (as the same may be amended or supplemented, the “Sublease Agreement'"); and WHEREAS, the Sublessor has advised the Agency of its desire to exercise its option, pursuant to Sections 10.1 and 10.3 of the Lease Agreement, to terminate the Company Lease, the Lease Agreement, and the Sublease Agreement by paying all Project Payments and any other amounts due and payable under the Lease Agreement (collectively, the “Project Payments"); and WHEREAS, concurrently with the execution of this Agreement, the Sublessor, in terminating this Agreement, pursuant to Section 10.3(a) of the Lease Agreement shall: (i) pay to NYCDOF any amounts due and payable pursuant to Section 5.1(i) of the Lease Agreement, (ii) pay to the Agency an amount equal to all Project Payments due thereunder, plus one dollar ($1.00), and (i) perform all accrued obligations under the Lease Agreement; and WHEREAS, concurrently with the execution of this Agreement, (i) the Sublessor and the Agency will terminate the Company Lease and (i) the Sublessor and the Agency will terminate the Lease Agreement; and WHEREAS, the Sublessor and the Sublessee desire to terminate the Sublease Agreement in accordance with this Agreement; and WHEREAS, all necessary consents and notices for the execution of this Agreement have been either obtained or waived; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises, the parties hereto agree asfollows: Section1. Termination of the Sublease Agreement.The Sublessor and the Sublessee hereby agree that the Sublease Agreement is terminated and cancelled as of the date hereof, subject to the survival of the obligations of the Sublessor under Sections 5.1 of the Lease Agreement (until such time as the Agency shall cease to have a leasehold estate in the Facility and, by reason thereto, the Sublessor shall again pay taxes as the record owner of the Facility 3974733.2048144CLD

3. Realty), 8.2, 9.2, 9.6, 9.7, 9.8, 11.4, 11.5, 11.6, 11.11, 11.13 and 11.14 of the Lease Agreement, which the Sublessee has agreed shall survive the termination of the Lease Agreement and the Sublease Agreement. Section 2.No Assignment of the Sublease Agreement. The parties hereby represent that their respective rights under the Sublease Agreement have not been assigned. Section 3. Counterparts.  This Agreement may be simultaneously executed in several counterparts, each of which shall be an original and all of which shall constitute but one and the same instrument. Section 4. Miscellaneous. (a)   This Agreement shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, thelawsoftheStateofNewYork. (b)  The Sublessor shall cause this Agreement to be recorded in the Office of the Register of The City of New York at its own cost and expense. (c) The terms of this Agreement are and shall be binding upon and inure to benefit of the Sublessor and the Sublessee and their respective successors and assigns.
